question: Which standing-teams policies should take effect: selected recommendations or all current defaults?
big_picture: Before the standing-teams programme runs, eight policies set its limits and permissions. I recommend all eight because they cap usage, reduce repeat permission requests and clarify team actions. The form lets you choose any subset; policies 3 and 5 are harder to undo and can stay at their defaults. Your answer is recorded and handed to the teams; without an answer, all defaults stay in force and the programme continues.
reason: Applying the recommendations sets clearer limits and removes repeated permission asks; leave lasting grants or permanent deletion unselected if you prefer.

options.label: Apply only the recommendations you select in the form; leave the rest at their defaults

technical_details: Research Desk standing-teams programme. Policies 1–8 and their exact recommended settings/defaults are in the attached decision page and worker brief. Evidence mentioned in the case is under work/evidence when present.
